ingameEffects.label: Fuel on the Rocks (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen is increased. When hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack or Assist Attack, the equipper's DMG is increased, stacking up to 10 times and lasting for 6s. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s. While off-field, the stack effect is doubled. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon obtaining the DMG increase effect, if the number of current stacks is greater than or equal to 5, then the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 50. This Anomaly Proficiency increase does not stack and lasts for 6s.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Increases the equipper's Energy Regen while off-field.
